description: Dated reviewed context for scenario channels. These are not automatic confirmations of current law, orders or plate tonnage.

sources.title: June 2026 adjustment to Section 232 metals tariff regimes
sources.scope: Direct trade-policy channel, but product and country treatment requires current verification
sources.summary: The June 1 proclamation amended the Section 232 metals framework and differentiated metals articles from certain derivatives. This dated document is context, not a determination of the current tariff on any plate shipment. The model assigns no numerical tariff premium. Future changes remain scenario risks.

sources.title: United States Data Center Energy Usage Report: 2025 Update
sources.scope: Electricity-demand scenarios; not a plate demand forecast
sources.summary: DOE/LBNL research projects substantial data-center electricity-demand growth with a wide scenario range. It does not estimate carbon steel plate tonnage. The forecast treats demand for selected power equipment, tanks and generator skids as a conditional plate channel; building frames and other steel products are distinguished.
